title: A cinematic street-style video of cool gangster cats wearing black hoodies…
content: A cinematic street-style video of cool gangster cats wearing black hoodies, bandanas, gold chains, and sneakers, walking confidently through a graffiti-covered urban street. Dynamic low-angle shots, realistic fur, dramatic lighting, hip-hop vibe, smooth camera movement, ultra-detailed, 4K.

Toma dinámica en ángulo bajo, pelaje realista, iluminación dramática, vibra hip-hop, movimiento de cámara fluido, ultra detallado, 4K.
